title: SynthCharge: An Electric Vehicle Routing Instance Generator with Feasibility Screening to Enable Learning-Based Optimization and Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2603.03230v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The electric vehicle routing problem with time windows (EVRPTW) extends the classical VRPTW by introducing battery capacity constraints and charging station decisions. Existing benchmark datasets are often static and lack verifiable feasibility, which restricts reproducible evaluation of learning-based routing models. We introduce SynthCharge, a parametric generator that produces diverse, feasibility-screened EVRPTW instances across varying spatiotemporal configurations and scalable customer counts. While SynthCharge can currently generate large-scale instances of up to 500 customers, we focus our experiments on sizes ranging from 5 to 100 customers. Unlike static benchmark suites, SynthCharge integrates instance geometry with adaptive energy capacity scaling and range-aware charging station placement. translated_title: SynthCharge：一种带可行性筛选的电动汽车路径规划实例生成器，用于支持基于学习的优化与基准测试
translated_abstract: 带时间窗的电动汽车路径规划问题（EVRPTW）通过引入电池容量约束和充电站决策，扩展了经典的VRPTW问题。现有的基准数据集通常是静态的，且缺乏可验证的可行性，这限制了基于学习的路径规划模型的可重复性评估。我们提出了SynthCharge，一个参数化生成器，能够在不同的时空配置和可扩展的客户数量下，生成多样化且经过可行性筛选的EVRPTW实例。尽管SynthCharge目前能够生成多达500个客户的大规模实例，但我们的实验主要集中在5到100个客户的规模上。与静态基准套件不同，SynthCharge将实例几何与自适应能量容量缩放和范围感知的充电站布置相结合。为了保证结构有效性，该生成器通过一个快速可行性筛选器系统地过滤掉不可解的实例。
tldr: SynthCharge是一种参数化实例生成器，通过快速可行性筛选生成多样且可验证的EVRPTW问题实例，填补了现有静态基准在可重复评估上的空白。
en_tdlr: SynthCharge is a parametric instance generator that creates diverse and feasibility-screened EVRPTW instances via fast screening, addressing the lack of reproducible benchmarks in learning-based routing.
